L1_AGE.description: Days since the perpetual contract was listed

L1_FLOAT.description: Circulating supply as a share of total supply

L1_HOLDER_CONC.description: Top-10 holder share, excluding known locked/bridge/staking contracts
L1_HOLDER_CONC.reason: not applicable: a chain's native coin has no token contract to read holders from

L1_MCAP_LIQ.description: Market-cap change divided by liquidations, on a 24h move above 100%
L1_MCAP_LIQ.reason: not applicable: 24h move of +3.0% is inside -50%/+100%

L1_NO_MCAP.description: Market cap resolvable from a market-data source

L1_OI_MCAP.description: Perp open-interest notional divided by circulating market cap

L1_PERP_SPOT.description: Perp 24h volume divided by same-venue spot 24h volume

L1_UNLOCK.description: Team/investor unlock above 5% of circulating within 30 days
